title: Unit, Formation, Squad, Fleet & Army Definition Model
objective: Implement reusable squad, unit, formation, fleet and army definition projections with explicit identity-preserving membership/composition, capability tags, descriptive readiness, equipment/platform references, provenance and visibility while preserving canonical constituent and owner-domain truth.

allowed_sources: MIB-14 vehicle/platform/base operational definitions and capability references
tranche_context.expansion_rule: Context expansion is denied unless a named source is missing/contradictory, changed validation evidence identifies a concrete dependency, canonical branch/authority state drifts, or the owner explicitly requests expansion.

resolved_contract.profile_rule: Profiles are reusable read-only aggregate definitions/projections. They never become duplicate Character, Creature, Asset, inventory, Vehicle, Organization, Combat, Event or World truth.
resolved_contract.membership_rule: Every visible membership row carries a stable membership id, profile id, member kind, member reference id, explicit leaf canonical constituent ids, owner references and provenance. Nested projected groups are permitted only when their leaf canonical constituent ids remain explicit; empty or divergent identity remains unknown/incompatible and is never inferred.
resolved_contract.composition_rule: Composition is the deterministic visible set of identity-preserving membership rows plus role tags. No universal size caps, automatic hierarchy or command authority is implied by profile kind or membership.
resolved_contract.capability_rule: Capability tags are explicit visible derived projection labels from source evidence only. SCL-02 computes no numeric combat power, qualification, command capacity or mechanical bonus.
resolved_contract.readiness_rule: Readiness is a descriptive projection band supported by explicit visible evidence. No thresholds, resource consumption, morale/logistics mechanics, action restrictions or effects are introduced; SCL-05/SCL-06 retain later morale/logistics/readiness mechanics.
resolved_contract.equipment_platform_rule: Equipment and platform references remain canonical D17/MIB-14 references with provenance. SCL-02 neither copies their state nor implements vehicle/fleet mechanics reserved for SCL-08.
resolved_contract.visibility_rule: Permission/visibility filtering occurs before membership inclusion, visible counts, composition, capabilities, readiness, equipment/platform references, summaries, search text, provenance, deterministic receipts or AI context. Hidden existence and hidden cardinality remain undisclosed.
resolved_contract.unknown_conflict_rule: Missing, explicit unknown, conflicting or identity-incompatible visible membership/evidence remains conservative and cannot be guessed, auto-reconciled or promoted to a complete profile.
resolved_contract.determinism_rule: Stable profile-kind, membership-id, canonical-reference and evidence-id ordering determines projection/receipt truth; presentation prose is excluded from canonical receipts.

authority_handoffs.SCL-03: command hierarchy, roles, orders and communication

resolved_contract.ai_rule: AI may advise only where separately governed. SCL-02 invokes no provider and grants no command, order, adjudication, permission, mutation or completion authority.
resolved_contract.persistence: No durable SCL-02 ledger or migration. Migration 0022 remains unreserved.

acceptance_contract.red_rule: Acceptance/proof/profile/verifier land before production contract/panel and must fail at the intended missing production imports after invariants/install pass on both self-hosted lanes.
acceptance_contract.green_rule: Exactly one SCL-02 current-family profile passes exact-head repository health, self-hosted Linux, self-hosted Windows and deterministic comparison with zero historical predecessor fanout.

preserved_boundaries: Canonical constituent, Asset/inventory, MIB-14 platform/base, ODL organization, Permission/visibility, Action/Combat/Event and owner-domain truth remain authoritative.
SCL-02 creates profile projections only; no command hierarchy/order, mechanical resolution, morale/logistics mechanics, casualty/damage mapping or strategic consequence commit is authorized.
No duplicate authoritative state/effects, owner mutation, AI command/adjudication, hidden-data reveal, durable persistence or migration 0022 is authorized.
SCL-03+, MAL-01+, provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.
